facts.text: Under the Saints Essentials program, undergraduate tuition covers student amenities including campus dining, parking permits, and fitness facilities.

sources.title: Tuition Benefits & Student Essentials - Thomas More University
sources.quote: Beginning with the Fall 2023 incoming class, new Saints will have all of their essential needs – from dining, to parking, to technology use – covered by their tuition.
